Valmont depot: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts, certified June 2023 (renewal due June 2028). Operations lead Halvard Onstad; night supervisor Teodora Blaskovic. Average 410 daily departures, winter peak 530; 1.8% cancellations. Night shift understaffed.

February 2025: brake line failure grounded nine vehicles four days; cause unresolved. Brake checks every 6,000 km. September 2024 fuel card cloning lost €4,200; second approval required above €200.

Electrification study approved but unfunded; second charging bay due Q3. Old ticketing terminal on three routes. Parts contract renegotiated November 2025; supplier contact Ingrid Solheim. Two quotations required above €500.

May 2026: duplicate roster left two shifts uncovered; single named publisher now required. Winter peak capacity next year unmodelled.
